g.text: Registered with the tas from the Issuance Mode of the Issue Profile
A VC Plan with DIRECT follows the standard
(Precondition) The certified app registers the user information
verified through KYC or a similar process with the CAS in advance (userId ↔ pii).
The issuer retrieves the pii from the CAS with the userId in the proxy request
to identify the user to issue to.
userId = User ID of the certified app
How the proxy authenticates the certified app
(session, access token, etc.) depends on the proxy
implementation and is beyond the scope of this specification.
DB : Retrieve the user registered in the issuer DB by pii and VC Schema
TEST : Generate test claims from the VC Schema at issuance time
API (external system lookup) : Not supported yet (SSRVISS00502)
In the standard procedure the tas generates authNonce.
In proxy mode the issuer uses issuerNonce as authNonce.
Proof = sign(seed | sha_pii | provider | nonce, CAS_PriKey)
CAS: Authorized App Provider (Authorization App Server)
In proxy mode the ECDH with the tas and the server token issuance are not performed.
The issuer verifies the holder directly through the DID Auth signed by the wallet.
SSRVISS00426 if the proof is missing
SSRVISS00210 if authNonce does not match
